Name: Barn Coop Freedom Android
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Barn-Coop Freedom - Android lets you use the animal "Change Home" menu to move an already-owned farm animal between Barn-family and Coop-family AnimalHouses on Android.

The mod is intentionally narrow: it changes the relocation rules for animals you already own, but it does not change where animals can be purchased, the building they originally require, or a building's capacity. A chicken still needs its normal Coop-family placement when purchased, a cow still needs its normal Barn-family placement when purchased, and full buildings are still rejected.

It was made specifically for the Android Stardew Valley / SMAPI animal-home UI path and is not a PC support release.

[b]Features[/b][/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Move already-owned farm animals from Barn-family houses to Coop-family houses.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Move already-owned farm animals from Coop-family houses to Barn-family houses.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Works with vanilla animals and compatible custom farm animals that use Stardew's normal FarmAnimal / AnimalHouse housing data.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Keeps the normal Android building-selection and confirmation flow.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves building capacity checks, so full target buildings are still rejected.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Preserves Marnie's purchase placement rules and each animal's original House.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Keeps an animal's Barn/Coop housing family aligned with its new home.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Requirements[/b][/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley for Android. Built and tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 build 26177.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.3.2 or newer compatible Android runtime. Tested on SMAPI 4.3.2.5.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
